clauses: Compare each status's average with the mean modulation index across all signals with nonmissing indices.
Compare each status's average with the unweighted mean of all statuses' average modulation indices.
readings: Which RFI statuses (`rfistat`) have an above-average modulation index (`modindex`)? Ignore missing index values, and treat signals with no status as their own group. For each such status, show the status, its average modulation index, how far above average it is, and how it differs from the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. Leave all values unrounded. Compare each status's average with the mean modulation index across all signals with nonmissing indices.

Which RFI statuses (`rfistat`) have an above-average modulation index (`modindex`)? Ignore missing index values, and treat signals with no status as their own group. For each such status, show the status, its average modulation index, how far above average it is, and how it differs from the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. Leave all values unrounded. Compare each status's average with the unweighted mean of all statuses' average modulation indices.
queries:
WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT rfistat,
           avg_modindex,
           avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL) AS above_average
    FROM status_averages
    WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_modindex,
       above_average,
       avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying

WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_of_status_averages
    FROM status_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex,
           sa.avg_modindex - oa.avg_of_status_averages AS above_average
    FROM status_averages AS sa
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.avg_of_status_averages
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_modindex,
       above_average,
       avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying
